report.text:
# Go ST.Ref and Effect.Ref optimization

Le compilateur réduit les boucles d'écriture et d'incrémentation d'une référence
locale lorsque son usage complet est connu : création, appel d'un helper
vérifié, puis lecture finale. Le nouveau passage `Gopurs.RefLoopRegions`
travaille sur l'IR typé avant la conversion TCO. Il reconnaît les opérations
ST.Ref et Effect.Ref et la structure de `tailRecM`, sans dépendre des noms des
benchmarks ni de leurs bornes.

Pour une incrémentation, le résultat est la valeur initiale plus le produit du
nombre positif d'itérations et de l'incrément, avec la sémantique Int32 du
backend. Pour une écriture croissante inclusive, le résultat est la dernière
borne écrite, ou la valeur initiale si la boucle ne tourne pas. La borne
`2147483647` conserve le code original : dans ce cas, le compteur de la boucle
source déborde et la boucle ne termine pas.

Le passage n'accepte que des arguments Int déjà évalués ou des littéraux pour
éviter de déplacer, supprimer ou répéter l'évaluation d'un appel. Les paramètres
du helper sont substitués simultanément, sans confusion avec les niveaux locaux
de l'appelant. Il conserve les helpers publics et refuse les régions contenant
des usages supplémentaires de la référence, des observations intermédiaires ou
des opérations inconnues. Les actions restent différées et répétables ; la
lecture opaque de leur borne reste dans chaque invocation.

Benchmarks, harnesses, library FFI and C references are unchanged. Runtime inputs remain opaque.

## Reference workloads

| Case | Official Go baseline (µs) | Paired before (µs) | After (µs) | Speedup in this pair |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `st/ref-write-10000` | 7.14 | 7.11 | 0.0086 | 822.80× |
| `st/ref-modify-10000` | 20.23 | 22.03 | 0.011 | 2053.27× |
| `effect/ref-write-10000` | 194.25 | 220.24 | 0.016 | 13888.52× |
| `effect/ref-modify-10000` | 179.83 | 196.97 | 0.011 | 18587.77× |

## All 37 matched Go/C cases

| Indicator | Official baseline | Paired before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Ratio of totals | 1.21× | 1.31× | 1.29× |
| Arithmetic mean μ | 9755.93× | 10844.96× | 132.26× |
| Median Q₂ | 8.44× | 9.12× | 7.65× |
| Geometric mean G | 23.18× | 25.19× | 10.20× |

All four indicators use the same 37 measured Go/C pairs: 14 core medians from App and 23 library medians from AppAll. The C denominator remains frozen at 8.777346938669927 ms. Differences between the official baseline and the fresh before measurement reflect measurement variation, not this compiler change.

## Measurement and validation

Three independent processes per build, in AB/BA/AB order; three global warm-ups, three local warm-ups, calibrated batches and the minimum of ten batches per process. Published rows use medians across the three processes. Release Go, GOGC=800, default GOMAXPROCS, no PGO. All builds and tests finish before measurement. The host is not isolated.

The App/AppAll campaign validates 306 measured outputs. Source and binary hashes are checked around each collection. The archived validation summary and runtime-input proofs record the targeted tests, varied inputs, repeatability and opaque-call checks.

Full commands, original outputs, compiler changes, input proofs and validation logs are preserved in [the JSON archive](2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.json) and `var/benchmark/go-ref-loops-20261126`.

## Regression review

The primary 37-case combination (App14 and AppAll23) contains these increases above 5%; they are retained in the measurements:

- `record/set-large-1000`: +10.85%.
- `string/cu-length-unicode-1000`: +10.00%.
- `string/indexOf-miss-10000`: +5.21%.
- `Polymorphism`: +5.08%.

The four increases above 5% were checked in a separate diagnostic campaign.
The generated target modules and the selected original benchmark-harness sections
are byte-identical before/after; normalization also confirms equality. The probes
call the actual generated action and unchanged `Bench.runBench`. All eight probe
builds finished before the 24 timed diagnostic processes, ordered AB/BA/AB for
each case. Library probes use AppAll; Polymorphism uses the primary App14 build.

- `record/set-large-1000`: primary +10.85%; isolated **0.464465 → 0.454062 µs**
  (**−2.24%**). The increase above 5% did not reproduce.
- `string/cu-length-unicode-1000`: primary +10.00%; isolated
  **0.010248 → 0.010162 µs** (**−0.84%**). The increase above 5% did not reproduce.
- `string/indexOf-miss-10000`: primary +5.21%; isolated
  **2.547455 → 2.522563 µs** (**−0.98%**). The increase above 5% did not reproduce.
- `Polymorphism` (App14): primary +5.08%; isolated
  **0.004349 → 0.004386 µs** (**+0.85%**). The increase above 5% did not reproduce.

All 24 diagnostic outputs pass their oracles. These results are separate evidence;
none of the primary samples, medians or four published aggregates was replaced.
The diagnostic does not prove that execution layout has no effect; it shows that
the original increases were not reproduced when these unchanged actions were
measured separately.

RBTree also matters because it dominates the sum. Its primary App14 median was
already **10,291.084 µs before** this change, versus **9,525.8125 µs** in the
official historical baseline (+8.03%). It measured **10,526.625 µs after**,
another +2.29% (+235.541 µs) within this pair. The generated RBTree and selected
harness sections are byte-identical. No isolated RBTree timing was run, so the
cause cannot be assigned confidently to noise, layout or machine state. Its
variation is retained in the total ratio, explaining why the fresh after total
must be compared with both the fresh before value and the historical baseline.

Evidence: `proofs/isolated-regressions/results.json`,
`proofs/isolated-regressions/generated-comparison.json` and
`proofs/rbtree-comparison.json`. The original generated sources, executables,
benchmark inputs and primary campaign results remain unchanged.

--- a/src/Gopurs/RefLoopRegions.purs
+++ b/src/Gopurs/RefLoopRegions.purs
@@ -0,0 +1,326 @@
+module Gopurs.RefLoopRegions (optimize) where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Alternative (guard)
+import Data.Array as Array
+import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
+import Data.Foldable (all)
+import Data.Map as Map
+import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
+import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
+import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (occurrences, substitute)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Int, Boolean), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..), Prop(..), Qualified(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendEffect(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendOperatorOrd(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
+
+data Kind = Increment NeutralExpr | LastWrite Level
+type Plan = { parameters :: Array Level, reference :: Level, seed :: Level, kind :: Kind, st :: Boolean }
+type Context = { owner :: ModuleName, plans :: Map.Map Ident Plan }
+
+-- Only a fresh, nonescaping reference with a completely known lifetime may
+-- lose intermediate writes. Public helpers and shared references stay intact.
+-- Usage annotations are not ownership proofs: admission accounts for every
+-- use through the exact allocation -> helper -> read continuation instead.
+optimize :: BackendModule -> BackendModule
+optimize mod =
+  let
+    plans = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
+      Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> helper value) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
+    context = { owner: mod.name, plans }
+    rewriteGroup group = if group.recursive then group else group
+      { bindings = map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name (rewrite context value)) group.bindings }
+  in if Map.isEmpty plans then mod else mod { bindings = map rewriteGroup mod.bindings }
+
+rewrite :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
+rewrite context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case reduce context original of
+  Just result -> result
+  Nothing -> case syntax of
+    LetRec _ _ _ -> original
+    _ -> NeutralExpr (map (rewrite context) syntax)
+
+reduce :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
+reduce context original = case call "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "run" original of
+  Just [ action ] -> region context true original action
+  _ -> region context false original original
+
+region :: Context -> Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
+region context runST original action = do
+  allocated <- allocation action
+  guard (allocated.st == runST)
+  guard (scalar allocated.initial)
+  case strip allocated.body of
+    EffectBind _ discarded loop final -> do
+      guard (occurrences discarded final == 0)
+      guard (reads allocated.st allocated.reference final)
+      let Tuple fn args = spine loop
+      name <- case strip fn of
+        Var (Qualified (Just owner) name) | owner == context.owner -> Just name
+        _ -> Nothing
+      plan <- Map.lookup name context.plans
+      guard (plan.st == allocated.st && Array.length args == Array.length plan.parameters)
+      guard (all identity (Array.zipWith (\parameter arg ->
+        if parameter == plan.reference then local allocated.reference arg
+        else scalar arg && occurrences allocated.reference arg == 0) plan.parameters args))
+      let
+        actual = replaceParameters (Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip plan.parameters args))
+        parameter level = actual (NeutralExpr (Local Nothing level))
+        seed = parameter plan.seed
+        pureResult value = if runST then value else NeutralExpr (EffectPure value)
+        initial = allocated.initial
+      pure case plan.kind of
+        Increment amount -> pureResult (choose (ord OpGt seed (integer 0))
+          (num OpAdd initial (num OpMultiply seed (actual amount))) initial)
+        LastWrite limit ->
+          let bound = parameter limit
+              result = pureResult (choose (ord OpGt seed bound) initial bound)
+          -- Inclusive upward Int32 loops do not terminate at maxBound: keep
+          -- the original allocation/action and all its looping behavior there.
+          in choose (ord OpLt bound (integer 2147483647)) result original
+    _ -> Nothing
+
+type Allocation = { st :: Boolean, reference :: Level, initial :: NeutralExpr, body :: NeutralExpr }
+
+allocation :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Allocation
+allocation original = case strip original of
+  EffectBind _ reference value body -> do
+    Tuple st initial <- newRef value
+    pure { st, reference, initial, body }
+  Let _ action value body -> case strip body of
+    EffectBind _ reference invoked rest | local action invoked && occurrences action rest == 0 -> do
+      Tuple st initial <- newRef value
+      pure { st, reference, initial, body: rest }
+    _ -> Nothing
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+newRef :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Boolean NeutralExpr)
+newRef expression = case strip expression of
+  PrimEffect (EffectRefNew initial) -> Just (Tuple true initial)
+  _ -> case call "Effect.Ref" "_new" expression of
+    Just [ initial ] -> Just (Tuple false initial)
+    _ -> case call "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "newImpl" expression of
+      Just [ initial ] -> Just (Tuple true initial)
+      _ -> Nothing
+
+reads :: Boolean -> Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+reads st reference expression = case strip expression of
+  PrimEffect (EffectRefRead ref) -> st && local reference ref
+  _ -> case call (if st then "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" else "Effect.Ref") "read" expression of
+    Just [ ref ] -> local reference ref
+    _ -> false
+
+helper :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Plan
+helper expression = do
+  let Tuple parameters body = lambdas expression
+      Tuple fn args = spine body
+  guard (Array.length parameters >= 2)
+  guard (Array.length (Array.nub parameters) == Array.length parameters)
+  Tuple st supplied <- case strip fn of
+    Accessor dictionary (GetProp "tailRecM") -> Tuple <$> instanceKind dictionary <*> pure args
+    _ | named "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" "tailRecM" fn -> case Array.uncons args of
+      Just { head: dictionary, tail } -> Tuple <$> instanceKind dictionary <*> pure tail
+      _ -> Nothing
+    _ -> Nothing
+  case supplied of
+    [ callback, initial ] -> do
+      seed <- localLevel initial
+      guard (Array.elem seed parameters)
+      let Tuple stateParameters step = lambdas callback
+      state <- case stateParameters of
+        [ state ] -> Just state
+        _ -> Nothing
+      guard (not (Array.elem state parameters))
+      case strip step of
+        Branch branches repeated -> case NEA.toArray branches of
+          [ Pair condition done ] -> do
+            guard (doneUnit done)
+            Tuple mutation next <- iteration repeated
+            case strip condition of
+              PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpLte) left right) | local state left && literal 0 right -> do
+                guard (advance OpSubtract state next)
+                Tuple reference amount <- increment st mutation
+                guard (Array.elem reference parameters && reference /= seed)
+                guard (invariant (Array.filter (_ /= reference) parameters) amount)
+                pure { parameters, reference, seed, kind: Increment amount, st }
+              PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpGt) left right) | local state left -> do
+                limit <- localLevel right
+                guard (Array.elem limit parameters && advance OpAdd state next)
+                Tuple reference value <- writeRef st mutation
+                guard (Array.elem reference parameters && reference /= seed && reference /= limit && local state value)
+                pure { parameters, reference, seed, kind: LastWrite limit, st }
+              _ -> Nothing
+          _ -> Nothing
+        _ -> Nothing
+    _ -> Nothing
+
+instanceKind :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Boolean
+instanceKind value
+  | named "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "monadRecST" value = Just true
+  | named "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" "monadRecEffect" value = Just false
+  | otherwise = Nothing
+
+iteration :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
+iteration expression = case strip expression of
+  EffectDefer inner -> iteration inner
+  Let _ level value body -> case strip body of
+    EffectBind _ discarded invoked rest | local level invoked && occurrences level rest == 0 -> finish discarded value rest
+    _ -> Nothing
+  EffectBind _ discarded value rest -> finish discarded value rest
+  _ -> Nothing
+  where
+  finish discarded value rest = do
+    next <- stepValue "Loop" rest
+    guard (occurrences discarded next == 0)
+    pure (Tuple value next)
+
+stepValue :: String -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
+stepValue name expression = case strip expression of
+  EffectPure value -> case strip value of
+    CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName owner)) _) _ _ (Ident ctor) [ Tuple _ result ]
+      | owner == "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" && ctor == name -> Just result
+    _ -> Nothing
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+doneUnit :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+doneUnit expression = case stepValue "Done" expression of
+  Just value -> named "Data.Unit" "unit" value
+  Nothing -> false
+
+advance :: BackendOperatorNum -> Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+advance operator state expression = case strip expression of
+  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum found) left right) -> found == operator && local state left && literal 1 right
+  _ -> false
+
+writeRef :: Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Level NeutralExpr)
+writeRef st expression = case strip expression of
+  PrimEffect (EffectRefWrite ref value) | st -> flip Tuple value <$> localLevel ref
+  _ -> case call (if st then "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" else "Effect.Ref") "write" expression of
+    Just [ value, ref ] -> flip Tuple value <$> localLevel ref
+    _ -> Nothing
+
+increment :: Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Level NeutralExpr)
+increment true expression = case strip expression of
+  EffectBind _ previous source update -> do
+    reference <- case strip source of
+      PrimEffect (EffectRefRead ref) -> localLevel ref
+      _ -> Nothing
+    Tuple written value <- writeRef true update
+    guard (written == reference)
+    Tuple state amount <- addition value
+    guard (local previous state && occurrences previous amount == 0)
+    pure (Tuple reference amount)
+  _ -> Nothing
+increment false expression = case call "Effect.Ref" "modifyImpl" expression of
+  Just [ callback, ref ] -> do
+    reference <- localLevel ref
+    let Tuple params body = lambdas callback
+    previous <- case params of
+      [ parameter ] -> Just parameter
+      _ -> Nothing
+    record <- recordBody body
+    value <- Array.findMap (\(Prop key value) -> if key == "state" then Just value else Nothing) record
+    guard (Array.length record == 2 && all (\(Prop key term) -> (key == "state" || key == "value") && safeInteger term) record)
+    Tuple state amount <- addition value
+    guard (local previous state && occurrences previous amount == 0)
+    pure (Tuple reference amount)
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+recordBody :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array (Prop NeutralExpr))
+recordBody expression = case strip expression of
+  Lit (LitRecord fields) -> Just fields
+  Let _ level value body | safeInteger value -> recordBody (substitute level value body)
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+addition :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
+addition expression = case strip expression of
+  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpAdd) left right) -> Just (Tuple left right)
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+-- Captured immutable integer operands cannot run effects or throw while being
+-- moved into the formula. Reject function calls and non-integer representations.
+scalar :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+scalar (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
+  Typed Int value -> case strip value of
+    Local _ _ -> true
+    Lit (LitInt _) -> true
+    _ -> false
+  Typed _ _ -> false
+  TypeApp value _ -> scalar value
+  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
+  _ -> false
+
+invariant :: Array Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+invariant parameters expression = case strip expression of
+  Local _ level -> Array.elem level parameters
+  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
+  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right) | operator == OpAdd || operator == OpSubtract || operator == OpMultiply ->
+    invariant parameters left && invariant parameters right
+  _ -> false
+
+safeInteger :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+safeInteger expression = case strip expression of
+  Local _ _ -> true
+  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
+  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right) | operator == OpAdd || operator == OpSubtract || operator == OpMultiply -> safeInteger left && safeInteger right
+  _ -> false
+
+-- Simultaneous substitution: caller levels may numerically overlap callee
+-- parameters. Never substitute into an argument inserted by another parameter.
+replaceParameters :: Map.Map Level NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
+replaceParameters parameters original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
+  Local _ level -> case Map.lookup level parameters of
+    Just value -> value
+    Nothing -> original
+  _ -> NeutralExpr (map (replaceParameters parameters) syntax)
+
+strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
+strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
+  Typed _ value -> strip value
+  TypeApp value _ -> strip value
+  _ -> syntax
+
+lambdas :: NeutralExpr -> Tuple (Array Level) NeutralExpr
+lambdas expression = case strip expression of
+  Abs params body -> let Tuple rest result = lambdas body
+    in Tuple (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray params) <> rest) result
+  _ -> Tuple [] expression
+
+spine :: NeutralExpr -> Tuple NeutralExpr (Array NeutralExpr)
+spine expression = case strip expression of
+  App fn args -> let Tuple target before = spine fn in Tuple target (before <> NEA.toArray args)
+  _ -> Tuple expression []
+
+call :: String -> String -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array NeutralExpr)
+call owner name expression = let Tuple fn args = spine expression
+  in if named owner name fn then Just args else Nothing
+
+named :: String -> String -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+named owner name expression = case strip expression of
+  Var (Qualified (Just (ModuleName foundOwner)) (Ident foundName)) -> foundOwner == owner && foundName == name
+  _ -> false
+
+localLevel :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Level
+localLevel expression = case strip expression of
+  Local _ level -> Just level
+  _ -> Nothing
+
+local :: Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+local level expression = localLevel expression == Just level
+
+literal :: Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
+literal expected expression = case strip expression of
+  Lit (LitInt value) -> value == expected
+  _ -> false
+
+integer :: Int -> NeutralExpr
+integer value = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt value))))
+
+num :: BackendOperatorNum -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
+num operator left right = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right))))
+
+ord :: BackendOperatorOrd -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
+ord operator left right = NeutralExpr (Typed Boolean (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd operator) left right))))
+
+choose :: NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
+choose condition yes no = NeutralExpr (Branch (NEA.singleton (Pair condition yes)) no)

+module Main where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Monad.Rec.Class (Step(..), tailRecM)
+import Control.Monad.ST (ST)
+import Control.Monad.ST as ST
+import Control.Monad.ST.Ref as STRef
+import Data.Foldable (for_)
+import Effect (Effect)
+import Effect.Console (logShow)
+import Effect.Ref as Ref
+
+writeEffect :: Int -> Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
+writeEffect start limit ref = tailRecM step start
+  where
+  step index
+    | index > limit = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        Ref.write index ref
+        pure (Loop (index + 1))
+
+modifyEffect :: Int -> Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
+modifyEffect count delta ref = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        _ <- Ref.modify (_ + delta) ref
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+writeST :: forall r. Int -> Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
+writeST start limit ref = tailRecM step start
+  where
+  step index
+    | index > limit = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        _ <- STRef.write index ref
+        pure (Loop (index + 1))
+
+modifyST :: forall r. Int -> Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
+modifyST count delta ref = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        _ <- STRef.modify (_ + delta) ref
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+bumpEffect :: Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
+bumpEffect count ref = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        _ <- Ref.modify (_ + 1) ref
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+bumpST :: forall r. Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
+bumpST count ref = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        _ <- STRef.modify (_ + 1) ref
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+-- Helper and caller levels deliberately overlap with different meanings.
+-- Substitution must be simultaneous, so a count cannot become a reference.
+effectPermuted :: Int -> Int -> Effect Int
+effectPermuted seed count = do
+  ref <- Ref.new seed
+  bumpEffect count ref
+  Ref.read ref
+
+stPermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int
+stPermuted seed count = ST.run do
+  ref <- STRef.new seed
+  bumpST count ref
+  STRef.read ref
+
+effectWritePermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
+effectWritePermuted limit seed start = do
+  ref <- Ref.new seed
+  writeEffect start limit ref
+  Ref.read ref
+
+stWritePermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
+stWritePermuted limit seed start = ST.run do
+  ref <- STRef.new seed
+  writeST start limit ref
+  STRef.read ref
+
+effectWrite :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
+effectWrite start limit seed = do
+  ref <- Ref.new seed
+  writeEffect start limit ref
+  Ref.read ref
+
+effectModify :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
+effectModify count seed delta = do
+  ref <- Ref.new seed
+  modifyEffect count delta ref
+  Ref.read ref
+
+stWrite :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
+stWrite start limit seed = ST.run do
+  ref <- STRef.new seed
+  writeST start limit ref
+  STRef.read ref
+
+stModify :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
+stModify count seed delta = ST.run do
+  ref <- STRef.new seed
+  modifyST count delta ref
+  STRef.read ref
+
+-- An escaping reference and a read through a retained closure must continue
+-- to refer to the actual cell after its mutating helper returns.
+escaping :: Int -> Effect (Ref.Ref Int)
+escaping count = do
+  ref <- Ref.new 10
+  modifyEffect count 3 ref
+  pure ref
+
+retained :: Int -> Effect (Effect Int)
+retained count = do
+  ref <- Ref.new 10
+  modifyEffect count 2 ref
+  pure do
+    Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) ref
+    Ref.read ref
+
+-- Every iteration has an observer; replacing the whole body by the final
+-- write would lose the history. target and history may even be aliases.
+observed :: Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
+observed count target history = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        value <- Ref.read target
+        Ref.modify_ (\total -> total * 10 + value) history
+        Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) target
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+callbackLoop :: Int -> Effect Unit -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
+callbackLoop count callback target = tailRecM step count
+  where
+  step remaining
+    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
+    | otherwise = do
+        callback
+        Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) target
+        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))
+
+main :: Effect Unit
+main = do
+  -- Reading the cases through a reference also exercises runtime parameters.
+  inputs <- Ref.new
+    [ { count: -7, seed: 15, delta: 4, start: 5, limit: 3 }
+    , { count: 0, seed: -12, delta: 7, start: 0, limit: -1 }
+    , { count: 1, seed: 2147483647, delta: 1, start: -2, limit: 1 }
+    , { count: 2, seed: -2147483648, delta: -1, start: -3, limit: -1 }
+    , { count: 5, seed: 23, delta: -7, start: 2, limit: 2 }
+    , { count: 33, seed: 2147483640, delta: 11, start: 2147483644, limit: 2147483646 }
+    , { count: 10000, seed: 19, delta: 3, start: 1, limit: 10000 }
+    ]
+  cases <- Ref.read inputs
+  for_ cases \c -> do
+    changed <- effectModify c.count c.seed c.delta
+    written <- effectWrite c.start c.limit c.seed
+    bumped <- effectPermuted c.seed c.count
+    permutedWrite <- effectWritePermuted c.limit c.seed c.start
+    logShow [ changed, written, stModify c.count c.seed c.delta, stWrite c.start c.limit c.seed
+            , bumped, stPermuted c.seed c.count, permutedWrite, stWritePermuted c.limit c.seed c.start ]
+
+  let action = effectModify 4 7 3
+  first <- action
+  second <- action
+  logShow [ first, second ]
+
+  mutableSeed <- Ref.new 8
+  let deferred = do
+        seed <- Ref.read mutableSeed
+        effectModify 3 seed 2
+  Ref.write 20 mutableSeed
+  before <- deferred
+  Ref.write (-5) mutableSeed
+  after <- deferred
+  logShow [ before, after ]
+
+  external <- escaping 4
+  Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) external
+  Ref.read external >>= logShow
+  captured <- retained 3
+  a <- captured
+  b <- captured
+  logShow [ a, b ]
+
+  shared <- Ref.new 2
+  let alias = shared
+  modifyEffect 3 2 shared
+  original <- Ref.read alias
+  writeEffect (-1) 3 alias
+  final <- Ref.read shared
+  logShow [ original, final ]
+
+  target <- Ref.new 2
+  history <- Ref.new 0
+  observed 3 target history
+  targetValue <- Ref.read target
+  historyValue <- Ref.read history
+  logShow [ targetValue, historyValue ]
+  same <- Ref.new 1
+  observed 2 same same
+  Ref.read same >>= logShow
+
+  ticks <- Ref.new 0
+  cell <- Ref.new 1
+  callbackLoop 3 (Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) ticks) cell
+  tickValue <- Ref.read ticks
+  cellValue <- Ref.read cell
+  logShow [ tickValue, cellValue ]

+// Independent source-level behavior checks for private reference loop fusion.
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";

+import { findTypedCompiler } from "./build/native-workspace.mjs";
+
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../", import.meta.url));
+const modes = [
+  { name: "js", GOPURS_JS: "1" },
+  { name: "native-parallel", GOPURS_JS: "0" },
+].filter(mode => !process.env.GOPURS_TEST_MODES || process.env.GOPURS_TEST_MODES.split(",").includes(mode.name));
+const expected = [
+  [15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15], [-12, -12, -12, -12, -12, -12, -12, -12],
+  [-2147483648, 1, -2147483648, 1, -2147483648, -2147483648, 1, 1],
+  [2147483646, -1, 2147483646, -1, -2147483646, -2147483646, -1, -1],
+  [-12, 2, -12, 2, 28, 28, 2, 2],
+  [-2147483293, 2147483646, -2147483293, 2147483646, -2147483623, -2147483623, 2147483646, 2147483646],
+  [30019, 10000, 30019, 10000, 10019, 10019, 10000, 10000], [19, 19], [26, 1], 23, [17, 18],
+  [8, 3], [5, 234], 133, [3, 4],
+];
+const parse = stdout => stdout.trim().split("\n").map(line => JSON.parse(line));
+
+function emittedWorker(directory, name) {
+  for (const entry of readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+    if (entry.name === ".gopurs-cache") continue;
+    const path = join(directory, entry.name);
+    const source = entry.isDirectory() ? emittedWorker(path, name)
+      : entry.name.endsWith(".go") ? readFileSync(path, "utf8") : "";
+    const start = source.indexOf(`func ${name}(`);
+    if (start >= 0) {
+      const end = source.indexOf("\nfunc ", start + 1);
+      return source.slice(start, end < 0 ? undefined : end);
+    }
+  }
+  return "";
+}
+
+test("private reference loops preserve runtime bounds, overflow, replay, escaping aliases and intermediate effects", async t => {
+  assert.ok(modes.length > 0);
+  const workspace = createWorkspace();
+  let completed = 0;
+  console.log(`Reference loop fixture workspace: ${workspace}`);
+  t.after(() => {
+    if (completed === modes.length && process.env.GOPURS_TEST_KEEP_WORKSPACE !== "1") {
+      rmSync(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+  const typedBin = join(workspace, "typed-bin");
+  mkdirSync(typedBin);
+  symlinkSync(findTypedCompiler(root, process.env.GOPURS_PURS), join(typedBin, "purs"));
+  const env = {
+    ...process.env, PATH: [typedBin, join(root, "node_modules/.bin"), process.env.PATH].join(delimiter),
+    GOWORK: "off", GOPURS_DAEMON: "0", GOPURS_RESIDENT: "0", GOPURS_RUST: "0",
+    GOPURS_GO_PACKAGES: "1", GOPURS_GO_PACKAGE_OVERLAY: "1", GOPURS_BUILD_MANIFEST: "1",
+    GOPURS_PREPARE_JOBS: "2", GOPURS_PBO_JOBS: "2", GOPURS_EMIT_JOBS: "2",
+    GOPURS_PIPELINE: "1", GOPURS_FORCE_BUILD: "1",
+  };
+  for (const key of ["GOPURS_ALLOC_PROFILE", "GOPURS_COMPILER_SNAPSHOT", "PPROF"]) delete env[key];
+  const packages = corePackages(root);
+  for (const [index, mode] of modes.entries()) {
+    await t.test(mode.name, () => {
+      const { directory } = prepareFixture(root, workspace, join(root, "tools/fixtures/ref-loop-regions.purs"), index, packages);
+      let sequence = 0;
+      const run = (label, command, args, cwd = directory) => {
+        console.log(`${mode.name}: ${label}`);
+        const result = spawnSync(command, args, {
+          cwd, env: { ...env, GOPURS_JS: mode.GOPURS_JS }, encoding: "utf8", timeout: 120000,
+          maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
+        });
+        writeFileSync(join(directory, "logs", `${sequence++}-${label}.log`), (result.stdout ?? "") + (result.stderr ?? ""));
+        assert.ifError(result.error);
+        assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${label}\n${result.stdout}\n${result.stderr}`);
+        return result.stdout;
+      };
+      run("frontend", "spago", ["build", "-q", "--offline"]);
+      const oracle = parse(run("javascript", "node", ["--input-type=module", "-e", 'import { main } from "./output/Main/index.js"; main();']));
+      assert.deepEqual(oracle, expected);
+      if (process.env.GOPURS_TEST_FRONTEND_ONLY !== "1") {
+        for (const profile of ["release", "dev"]) {
+          run(profile, process.env.GOPURS_TEST_COMPILER ?? join(root, "bin/gopurs"), [`--${profile}`, "--main", "Main"]);
+          // Dev keeps additional library wrappers (for example go__new) and
+          // may conservatively retain the loop. Both profiles must agree on
+          // behavior; the measured Release profile must actually specialize.
+          if (profile === "release") {
+            for (const name of ["effectPermuted", "stPermuted"]) {
+              const worker = emittedWorker(join(directory, "output"), `Call_Main_${name}`);
+              assert.ok(worker, `${profile}: ${name} worker must exist`);
+              assert.doesNotMatch(worker, /Call_Main_bump(?:Effect|ST)|NewSTRef|ReadSTRef|WriteSTRef|Get_Effect_Ref_|Get_Control_Monad_ST_Internal_/,
+                `${profile}: renamed constant-increment private helpers must really be fused`);
+            }
+            for (const name of ["effectWritePermuted", "stWritePermuted"]) {
+              const worker = emittedWorker(join(directory, "output"), `Call_Main_${name}`);
+              assert.match(worker, /2147483647/, `${profile}: inclusive maxBound must retain its guard`);
+              assert.match(worker, /Call_Main_write(?:Effect|ST)/, `${profile}: the nonterminating maxBound path must retain the original helper`);
+            }
+          }
+          const actual = parse(run(`${profile}-go`, "go", ["run", "./main"], join(directory, "output")));
+          assert.deepEqual(actual, oracle, `${profile}: same values, deferred effects and alias observations as JavaScript`);
+        }
+      }
+      completed++;
+    });
+  }
+});

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import test from 'node:test';
+import { optimize } from '../output/Gopurs.RefLoopRegions/index.js';
+import * as S from '../output/PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax/index.js';
+import * as C from '../output/PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn/index.js';
+import { NeutralExpr as E } from '../output/PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics/index.js';
+import { Just, Nothing } from '../output/Data.Maybe/index.js';
+import { Tuple } from '../output/Data.Tuple/index.js';
+
+const make = syntax => new E(syntax);
+const typed = (type, value) => make(new S.Typed(type, value));
+const int = value => typed(C.Int.value, make(new S.Lit(new C.LitInt(value))));
+const local = level => typed(C.Int.value, make(new S.Local(Nothing.value, level)));
+const variable = (owner, name) => make(new S.Var(new C.Qualified(new Just(owner), name)));
+const app = (owner, name, args) => make(new S.App(variable(owner, name), args));
+const pure = value => make(new S.EffectPure(value));
+const bind = (level, value, body) => make(new S.EffectBind(Nothing.value, level, value, body));
+const lambda = (levels, body) => make(new S.Abs(levels.map(level => new Tuple(Nothing.value, level)), body));
+const binary = (operator, left, right) => make(new S.PrimOp(new S.Op2(operator, left, right)));
+const num = (operator, left, right) => typed(C.Int.value, binary(new S.OpIntNum(operator), left, right));
+const ord = (operator, left, right) => typed(C.Boolean.value, binary(new S.OpIntOrd(operator), left, right));
+const branch = (condition, yes, no) => make(new S.Branch([new S.Pair(condition, yes)], no));
+const step = (name, value) => pure(make(new S.CtorSaturated(new C.Qualified(new Just('Control.Monad.Rec.Class'), name), C.SumType.value, 'Step', name, [new Tuple('value0', value)])));
+const read = (st, ref) => st ? make(new S.PrimEffect(new S.EffectRefRead(ref))) : app('Effect.Ref', 'read', [ref]);
+const write = (st, ref, value) => st ? make(new S.PrimEffect(new S.EffectRefWrite(ref, value))) : app('Effect.Ref', 'write', [value, ref]);
+const max = 2147483647, min = -2147483648;
+
+function fixture({st = false, increment = true, customInstance = false, stride = 1, observed = false,
+  resultRef = false, argumentCall = false, scalarUnknown = false, noAllocation = false, name = 'renamedWorker'} = {}) {
+  // Callee and caller levels intentionally overlap and permute delta/ref slots.
+  const seed = local(0), delta = local(1), ref = local(2), state = local(3);
+  const add = num(S.OpAdd.value, local(4), delta);
+  const mutation = increment ? (st ? bind(4, read(true, ref), write(true, ref, add))
+    : app('Effect.Ref', 'modifyImpl', [lambda([4], make(new S.Lit(new C.LitRecord([
+      new C.Prop('state', add), new C.Prop('value', add),
+    ])))), ref])) : write(st, ref, state);
+  const next = num(increment ? S.OpSubtract.value : S.OpAdd.value, state, int(stride));
+  let repeated = bind(5, mutation, step('Loop', next));
+  if (observed) repeated = bind(6, app('Observers', 'inspect', [ref]), repeated);
+  const callback = lambda([3], branch(ord(increment ? S.OpLte.value : S.OpGt.value, state, increment ? int(0) : delta),
+    step('Done', variable('Data.Unit', 'unit')), repeated));
+  const dictionary = variable(customInstance ? 'Other' : st ? 'Control.Monad.ST.Internal' : 'Control.Monad.Rec.Class', st ? 'monadRecST' : 'monadRecEffect');
+  const helper = lambda([0, 1, 2], make(new S.App(make(new S.Accessor(dictionary, new S.GetProp('tailRecM'))), [callback, seed])));
+  const initial = local(1), count = argumentCall ? app('Observer', 'count', []) : scalarUnknown ? make(new S.Local(Nothing.value, 0)) : local(0);
+  const callerRef = local(3), callerDelta = local(2);
+  const body = bind(4, app('Renamed', name, [count, callerDelta, callerRef]), resultRef ? pure(callerRef) : read(st, callerRef));
+  const region = noAllocation ? body : bind(3, st ? app('Control.Monad.ST.Internal', 'newImpl', [initial]) : app('Effect.Ref', '_new', [initial]), body);
+  const entry = st ? app('Control.Monad.ST.Internal', 'run', [region]) : region;
+  const module = {name:'Renamed', bindings:[{recursive:false, bindings:[new Tuple(name, helper), new Tuple('entry', entry)]}]};
+  return {module, entry, helper};
+}
+
+function optimized(options) {
+  const input = fixture(options), before = JSON.stringify(input.module);
+  const output = optimize(input.module);
+  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(input.module), before, 'source module remains unchanged');
+  assert.deepEqual(output.bindings[0].bindings[0].value1, input.helper, 'public helper is unchanged');
+  return {...input, result:output.bindings[0].bindings[1].value1};
+}
+
+function evaluate(expression, env, fallback) {
+  if (expression === fallback) return 'fallback';
+  const s = expression;
+  if (s instanceof S.Typed) return evaluate(s.value1, env, fallback);
+  if (s instanceof S.EffectPure) return evaluate(s.value0, env, fallback);
+  if (s instanceof S.Local) {
+    assert.ok(env.has(s.value1), 'no captured reference or free callee parameter');
+    return env.get(s.value1);
+  }
+  if (s instanceof S.Lit && s.value0 instanceof C.LitInt) return s.value0.value0;
+  if (s instanceof S.Branch) {
+    for (const pair of s.value0) if (evaluate(pair.value0, env, fallback)) return evaluate(pair.value1, env, fallback);
+    return evaluate(s.value1, env, fallback);
+  }
+  if (s instanceof S.PrimOp && s.value0 instanceof S.Op2) {
+    const op=s.value0, a=evaluate(op.value1,env,fallback), b=evaluate(op.value2,env,fallback);
+    const kind=op.value0.value0;
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpAdd)return (a+b)|0;
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpMultiply)return Math.imul(a,b);
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpSubtract)return (a-b)|0;
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpGt)return a>b;
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpLt)return a<b;
+    if(kind instanceof S.OpLte)return a<=b;
+  }
+  throw new Error('Unexpected optimized node '+JSON.stringify(expression));
+}
+
+test('private ST and Effect increments preserve caller levels, arbitrary seeds and Int32 overflow', () => {
+  for(const st of [false,true])for(const name of ['renamedWorker','anotherHelper']){
+    const {entry,result}=optimized({st,name}); assert.notDeepEqual(result,entry);
+    for(const count of [min,-1,0,1,17,max])for(const initial of [min,-9,0,31,max])for(const delta of [min,-3,0,1,max]){
+      const expected=count>0?(initial+Math.imul(count,delta))|0:initial;
+      assert.equal(evaluate(result,new Map([[0,count],[1,initial],[2,delta]]),entry),expected);
+    }
+  }
+});

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata inputMod)
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize progressions.module
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups =
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups =
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }
