module Gopurs.RefLoopRegions (optimize) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (occurrences, substitute)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Int, Boolean), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..), Prop(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendEffect(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendOperatorOrd(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))

data Kind = Increment NeutralExpr | LastWrite Level
type Plan = { parameters :: Array Level, reference :: Level, seed :: Level, kind :: Kind, st :: Boolean }
type Context = { owner :: ModuleName, plans :: Map.Map Ident Plan }

-- Only a fresh, nonescaping reference with a completely known lifetime may
-- lose intermediate writes. Public helpers and shared references stay intact.
-- Usage annotations are not ownership proofs: admission accounts for every
-- use through the exact allocation -> helper -> read continuation instead.
optimize :: BackendModule -> BackendModule
optimize mod =
  let
    plans = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> helper value) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    context = { owner: mod.name, plans }
    rewriteGroup group = if group.recursive then group else group
      { bindings = map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name (rewrite context value)) group.bindings }
  in if Map.isEmpty plans then mod else mod { bindings = map rewriteGroup mod.bindings }

rewrite :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
rewrite context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case reduce context original of
  Just result -> result
  Nothing -> case syntax of
    LetRec _ _ _ -> original
    _ -> NeutralExpr (map (rewrite context) syntax)

reduce :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
reduce context original = case call "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "run" original of
  Just [ action ] -> region context true original action
  _ -> region context false original original

region :: Context -> Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
region context runST original action = do
  allocated <- allocation action
  guard (allocated.st == runST)
  guard (scalar allocated.initial)
  case strip allocated.body of
    EffectBind _ discarded loop final -> do
      guard (occurrences discarded final == 0)
      guard (reads allocated.st allocated.reference final)
      let Tuple fn args = spine loop
      name <- case strip fn of
        Var (Qualified (Just owner) name) | owner == context.owner -> Just name
        _ -> Nothing
      plan <- Map.lookup name context.plans
      guard (plan.st == allocated.st && Array.length args == Array.length plan.parameters)
      guard (all identity (Array.zipWith (\parameter arg ->
        if parameter == plan.reference then local allocated.reference arg
        else scalar arg && occurrences allocated.reference arg == 0) plan.parameters args))
      let
        actual = replaceParameters (Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip plan.parameters args))
        parameter level = actual (NeutralExpr (Local Nothing level))
        seed = parameter plan.seed
        pureResult value = if runST then value else NeutralExpr (EffectPure value)
        initial = allocated.initial
      pure case plan.kind of
        Increment amount -> pureResult (choose (ord OpGt seed (integer 0))
          (num OpAdd initial (num OpMultiply seed (actual amount))) initial)
        LastWrite limit ->
          let bound = parameter limit
              result = pureResult (choose (ord OpGt seed bound) initial bound)
          -- Inclusive upward Int32 loops do not terminate at maxBound: keep
          -- the original allocation/action and all its looping behavior there.
          in choose (ord OpLt bound (integer 2147483647)) result original
    _ -> Nothing

type Allocation = { st :: Boolean, reference :: Level, initial :: NeutralExpr, body :: NeutralExpr }

allocation :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Allocation
allocation original = case strip original of
  EffectBind _ reference value body -> do
    Tuple st initial <- newRef value
    pure { st, reference, initial, body }
  Let _ action value body -> case strip body of
    EffectBind _ reference invoked rest | local action invoked && occurrences action rest == 0 -> do
      Tuple st initial <- newRef value
      pure { st, reference, initial, body: rest }
    _ -> Nothing
  _ -> Nothing

newRef :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Boolean NeutralExpr)
newRef expression = case strip expression of
  PrimEffect (EffectRefNew initial) -> Just (Tuple true initial)
  _ -> case call "Effect.Ref" "_new" expression of
    Just [ initial ] -> Just (Tuple false initial)
    _ -> case call "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "newImpl" expression of
      Just [ initial ] -> Just (Tuple true initial)
      _ -> Nothing

reads :: Boolean -> Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
reads st reference expression = case strip expression of
  PrimEffect (EffectRefRead ref) -> st && local reference ref
  _ -> case call (if st then "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" else "Effect.Ref") "read" expression of
    Just [ ref ] -> local reference ref
    _ -> false

helper :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Plan
helper expression = do
  let Tuple parameters body = lambdas expression
      Tuple fn args = spine body
  guard (Array.length parameters >= 2)
  guard (Array.length (Array.nub parameters) == Array.length parameters)
  Tuple st supplied <- case strip fn of
    Accessor dictionary (GetProp "tailRecM") -> Tuple <$> instanceKind dictionary <*> pure args
    _ | named "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" "tailRecM" fn -> case Array.uncons args of
      Just { head: dictionary, tail } -> Tuple <$> instanceKind dictionary <*> pure tail
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  case supplied of
    [ callback, initial ] -> do
      seed <- localLevel initial
      guard (Array.elem seed parameters)
      let Tuple stateParameters step = lambdas callback
      state <- case stateParameters of
        [ state ] -> Just state
        _ -> Nothing
      guard (not (Array.elem state parameters))
      case strip step of
        Branch branches repeated -> case NEA.toArray branches of
          [ Pair condition done ] -> do
            guard (doneUnit done)
            Tuple mutation next <- iteration repeated
            case strip condition of
              PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpLte) left right) | local state left && literal 0 right -> do
                guard (advance OpSubtract state next)
                Tuple reference amount <- increment st mutation
                guard (Array.elem reference parameters && reference /= seed)
                guard (invariant (Array.filter (_ /= reference) parameters) amount)
                pure { parameters, reference, seed, kind: Increment amount, st }
              PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpGt) left right) | local state left -> do
                limit <- localLevel right
                guard (Array.elem limit parameters && advance OpAdd state next)
                Tuple reference value <- writeRef st mutation
                guard (Array.elem reference parameters && reference /= seed && reference /= limit && local state value)
                pure { parameters, reference, seed, kind: LastWrite limit, st }
              _ -> Nothing
          _ -> Nothing
        _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing

instanceKind :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Boolean
instanceKind value
  | named "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" "monadRecST" value = Just true
  | named "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" "monadRecEffect" value = Just false
  | otherwise = Nothing

iteration :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
iteration expression = case strip expression of
  EffectDefer inner -> iteration inner
  Let _ level value body -> case strip body of
    EffectBind _ discarded invoked rest | local level invoked && occurrences level rest == 0 -> finish discarded value rest
    _ -> Nothing
  EffectBind _ discarded value rest -> finish discarded value rest
  _ -> Nothing
  where
  finish discarded value rest = do
    next <- stepValue "Loop" rest
    guard (occurrences discarded next == 0)
    pure (Tuple value next)

stepValue :: String -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
stepValue name expression = case strip expression of
  EffectPure value -> case strip value of
    CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName owner)) _) _ _ (Ident ctor) [ Tuple _ result ]
      | owner == "Control.Monad.Rec.Class" && ctor == name -> Just result
    _ -> Nothing
  _ -> Nothing

doneUnit :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
doneUnit expression = case stepValue "Done" expression of
  Just value -> named "Data.Unit" "unit" value
  Nothing -> false

advance :: BackendOperatorNum -> Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
advance operator state expression = case strip expression of
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum found) left right) -> found == operator && local state left && literal 1 right
  _ -> false

writeRef :: Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Level NeutralExpr)
writeRef st expression = case strip expression of
  PrimEffect (EffectRefWrite ref value) | st -> flip Tuple value <$> localLevel ref
  _ -> case call (if st then "Control.Monad.ST.Internal" else "Effect.Ref") "write" expression of
    Just [ value, ref ] -> flip Tuple value <$> localLevel ref
    _ -> Nothing

increment :: Boolean -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple Level NeutralExpr)
increment true expression = case strip expression of
  EffectBind _ previous source update -> do
    reference <- case strip source of
      PrimEffect (EffectRefRead ref) -> localLevel ref
      _ -> Nothing
    Tuple written value <- writeRef true update
    guard (written == reference)
    Tuple state amount <- addition value
    guard (local previous state && occurrences previous amount == 0)
    pure (Tuple reference amount)
  _ -> Nothing
increment false expression = case call "Effect.Ref" "modifyImpl" expression of
  Just [ callback, ref ] -> do
    reference <- localLevel ref
    let Tuple params body = lambdas callback
    previous <- case params of
      [ parameter ] -> Just parameter
      _ -> Nothing
    record <- recordBody body
    value <- Array.findMap (\(Prop key value) -> if key == "state" then Just value else Nothing) record
    guard (Array.length record == 2 && all (\(Prop key term) -> (key == "state" || key == "value") && safeInteger term) record)
    Tuple state amount <- addition value
    guard (local previous state && occurrences previous amount == 0)
    pure (Tuple reference amount)
  _ -> Nothing

recordBody :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array (Prop NeutralExpr))
recordBody expression = case strip expression of
  Lit (LitRecord fields) -> Just fields
  Let _ level value body | safeInteger value -> recordBody (substitute level value body)
  _ -> Nothing

addition :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
addition expression = case strip expression of
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpAdd) left right) -> Just (Tuple left right)
  _ -> Nothing

-- Captured immutable integer operands cannot run effects or throw while being
-- moved into the formula. Reject function calls and non-integer representations.
scalar :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
scalar (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed Int value -> case strip value of
    Local _ _ -> true
    Lit (LitInt _) -> true
    _ -> false
  Typed _ _ -> false
  TypeApp value _ -> scalar value
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  _ -> false

invariant :: Array Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
invariant parameters expression = case strip expression of
  Local _ level -> Array.elem level parameters
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right) | operator == OpAdd || operator == OpSubtract || operator == OpMultiply ->
    invariant parameters left && invariant parameters right
  _ -> false

safeInteger :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
safeInteger expression = case strip expression of
  Local _ _ -> true
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right) | operator == OpAdd || operator == OpSubtract || operator == OpMultiply -> safeInteger left && safeInteger right
  _ -> false

-- Simultaneous substitution: caller levels may numerically overlap callee
-- parameters. Never substitute into an argument inserted by another parameter.
replaceParameters :: Map.Map Level NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
replaceParameters parameters original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Local _ level -> case Map.lookup level parameters of
    Just value -> value
    Nothing -> original
  _ -> NeutralExpr (map (replaceParameters parameters) syntax)

strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed _ value -> strip value
  TypeApp value _ -> strip value
  _ -> syntax

lambdas :: NeutralExpr -> Tuple (Array Level) NeutralExpr
lambdas expression = case strip expression of
  Abs params body -> let Tuple rest result = lambdas body
    in Tuple (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray params) <> rest) result
  _ -> Tuple [] expression

spine :: NeutralExpr -> Tuple NeutralExpr (Array NeutralExpr)
spine expression = case strip expression of
  App fn args -> let Tuple target before = spine fn in Tuple target (before <> NEA.toArray args)
  _ -> Tuple expression []

call :: String -> String -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array NeutralExpr)
call owner name expression = let Tuple fn args = spine expression
  in if named owner name fn then Just args else Nothing

named :: String -> String -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
named owner name expression = case strip expression of
  Var (Qualified (Just (ModuleName foundOwner)) (Ident foundName)) -> foundOwner == owner && foundName == name
  _ -> false

localLevel :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Level
localLevel expression = case strip expression of
  Local _ level -> Just level
  _ -> Nothing

local :: Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
local level expression = localLevel expression == Just level

literal :: Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
literal expected expression = case strip expression of
  Lit (LitInt value) -> value == expected
  _ -> false

integer :: Int -> NeutralExpr
integer value = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt value))))

num :: BackendOperatorNum -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
num operator left right = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right))))

ord :: BackendOperatorOrd -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
ord operator left right = NeutralExpr (Typed Boolean (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd operator) left right))))

choose :: NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
choose condition yes no = NeutralExpr (Branch (NEA.singleton (Pair condition yes)) no)

module Main where

import Prelude

import Control.Monad.Rec.Class (Step(..), tailRecM)
import Control.Monad.ST (ST)
import Control.Monad.ST as ST
import Control.Monad.ST.Ref as STRef
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Effect.Ref as Ref

writeEffect :: Int -> Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
writeEffect start limit ref = tailRecM step start
  where
  step index
    | index > limit = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        Ref.write index ref
        pure (Loop (index + 1))

modifyEffect :: Int -> Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
modifyEffect count delta ref = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        _ <- Ref.modify (_ + delta) ref
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

writeST :: forall r. Int -> Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
writeST start limit ref = tailRecM step start
  where
  step index
    | index > limit = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        _ <- STRef.write index ref
        pure (Loop (index + 1))

modifyST :: forall r. Int -> Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
modifyST count delta ref = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        _ <- STRef.modify (_ + delta) ref
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

bumpEffect :: Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
bumpEffect count ref = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        _ <- Ref.modify (_ + 1) ref
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

bumpST :: forall r. Int -> STRef.STRef r Int -> ST r Unit
bumpST count ref = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        _ <- STRef.modify (_ + 1) ref
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

-- Helper and caller levels deliberately overlap with different meanings.
-- Substitution must be simultaneous, so a count cannot become a reference.
effectPermuted :: Int -> Int -> Effect Int
effectPermuted seed count = do
  ref <- Ref.new seed
  bumpEffect count ref
  Ref.read ref

stPermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int
stPermuted seed count = ST.run do
  ref <- STRef.new seed
  bumpST count ref
  STRef.read ref

effectWritePermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
effectWritePermuted limit seed start = do
  ref <- Ref.new seed
  writeEffect start limit ref
  Ref.read ref

stWritePermuted :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
stWritePermuted limit seed start = ST.run do
  ref <- STRef.new seed
  writeST start limit ref
  STRef.read ref

effectWrite :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
effectWrite start limit seed = do
  ref <- Ref.new seed
  writeEffect start limit ref
  Ref.read ref

effectModify :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Effect Int
effectModify count seed delta = do
  ref <- Ref.new seed
  modifyEffect count delta ref
  Ref.read ref

stWrite :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
stWrite start limit seed = ST.run do
  ref <- STRef.new seed
  writeST start limit ref
  STRef.read ref

stModify :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
stModify count seed delta = ST.run do
  ref <- STRef.new seed
  modifyST count delta ref
  STRef.read ref

-- An escaping reference and a read through a retained closure must continue
-- to refer to the actual cell after its mutating helper returns.
escaping :: Int -> Effect (Ref.Ref Int)
escaping count = do
  ref <- Ref.new 10
  modifyEffect count 3 ref
  pure ref

retained :: Int -> Effect (Effect Int)
retained count = do
  ref <- Ref.new 10
  modifyEffect count 2 ref
  pure do
    Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) ref
    Ref.read ref

-- Every iteration has an observer; replacing the whole body by the final
-- write would lose the history. target and history may even be aliases.
observed :: Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
observed count target history = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        value <- Ref.read target
        Ref.modify_ (\total -> total * 10 + value) history
        Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) target
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

callbackLoop :: Int -> Effect Unit -> Ref.Ref Int -> Effect Unit
callbackLoop count callback target = tailRecM step count
  where
  step remaining
    | remaining <= 0 = pure (Done unit)
    | otherwise = do
        callback
        Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) target
        pure (Loop (remaining - 1))

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  -- Reading the cases through a reference also exercises runtime parameters.
  inputs <- Ref.new
    [ { count: -7, seed: 15, delta: 4, start: 5, limit: 3 }
    , { count: 0, seed: -12, delta: 7, start: 0, limit: -1 }
    , { count: 1, seed: 2147483647, delta: 1, start: -2, limit: 1 }
    , { count: 2, seed: -2147483648, delta: -1, start: -3, limit: -1 }
    , { count: 5, seed: 23, delta: -7, start: 2, limit: 2 }
    , { count: 33, seed: 2147483640, delta: 11, start: 2147483644, limit: 2147483646 }
    , { count: 10000, seed: 19, delta: 3, start: 1, limit: 10000 }
    ]
  cases <- Ref.read inputs
  for_ cases \c -> do
    changed <- effectModify c.count c.seed c.delta
    written <- effectWrite c.start c.limit c.seed
    bumped <- effectPermuted c.seed c.count
    permutedWrite <- effectWritePermuted c.limit c.seed c.start
    logShow [ changed, written, stModify c.count c.seed c.delta, stWrite c.start c.limit c.seed
            , bumped, stPermuted c.seed c.count, permutedWrite, stWritePermuted c.limit c.seed c.start ]

  let action = effectModify 4 7 3
  first <- action
  second <- action
  logShow [ first, second ]

  mutableSeed <- Ref.new 8
  let deferred = do
        seed <- Ref.read mutableSeed
        effectModify 3 seed 2
  Ref.write 20 mutableSeed
  before <- deferred
  Ref.write (-5) mutableSeed
  after <- deferred
  logShow [ before, after ]

  external <- escaping 4
  Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) external
  Ref.read external >>= logShow
  captured <- retained 3
  a <- captured
  b <- captured
  logShow [ a, b ]

  shared <- Ref.new 2
  let alias = shared
  modifyEffect 3 2 shared
  original <- Ref.read alias
  writeEffect (-1) 3 alias
  final <- Ref.read shared
  logShow [ original, final ]

  target <- Ref.new 2
  history <- Ref.new 0
  observed 3 target history
  targetValue <- Ref.read target
  historyValue <- Ref.read history
  logShow [ targetValue, historyValue ]
  same <- Ref.new 1
  observed 2 same same
  Ref.read same >>= logShow

  ticks <- Ref.new 0
  cell <- Ref.new 1
  callbackLoop 3 (Ref.modify_ (_ + 1) ticks) cell
  tickValue <- Ref.read ticks
  cellValue <- Ref.read cell
  logShow [ tickValue, cellValue ]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archive the completed reference-loop campaign and its independently checked evidence."""
import argparse, difflib, hashlib, json, math, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
COMPILER = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.json'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.md'
SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def artifact(path, omit=False):
    path = Path(path)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    result = {'sha256': sha(data), 'size_bytes': len(data)}
    if omit:
        result.update(text_omitted='Large generated overlay; reconstruct using the archived proof script, patch and original source hash.',
                      retained_path=str(path))
    else:
        result['text'] = data.decode('utf-8')
    return result


def verify(path, expected):
    if sha(Path(path).read_bytes()) != expected:
        raise ValueError('Hash mismatch: ' + str(path))


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), *args], text=True)


def check_campaign(campaign):
    pair = runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py'))
    pair['verify_freeze'](campaign['frozen_reference'])
    pair['C']['verify_hashes'](campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256'])
    for entry in campaign['core_manifest']['plan']:
        verify(entry['manifest'], entry['manifest_sha256'])
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](entry['payload_sha256'])
    all_cases = campaign['all_campaign']
    for variant, directory in all_cases['workspaces'].items():
        verify(Path(directory) / 'manifest.json', all_cases['manifest_sha256'][variant])
        verify(Path(directory) / 'benchmark', all_cases['executable_sha256'][variant])
    verify(WORK / 'campaign/core/results.json', campaign['core_manifest']['results_sha256'])
    verify(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py', campaign['wrapper_sha256'])
    for variant, times in campaign['matched37_times_us'].items():
        assert len(times) == 37
        combined = dict(campaign['primary_times_us'][variant])
        combined.update({name: row['medians_us'][variant] for name, row in all_cases['all_tests'].items()
                         if name not in combined})
        assert times == combined
        expected = pair['metrics'](times, campaign['frozen_reference']['c37_times_us'])
        for metric, value in expected.items():
            assert math.isclose(value, campaign['aggregates'][variant][metric], rel_tol=1e-12)
    assert campaign['validation']['total_oracles'] == 306
    return {'cases': 37, 'oracles': 306, 'protected_current_files': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['source_sha256']),
            'protected_library_sources': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['library_sources_sha256']),
            'compiler_files': len(campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256']), 'all_guards_passed': True}


def check_inputs(campaign):
    result = {}
    expected_inputs, expected_stdout = None, None
    for variant in ('before', 'after'):
        directory = WORK / 'proofs' / ('runtime-inputs-' + variant)
        manifest = json.loads((directory / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['validated'] is True
        assert manifest['input_variants'] == 56 and manifest['oracles'] == 168
        assert manifest['paths'] == ['Apply', 'ffi_conversion', 'forced_fallback']
        assert manifest['preparation_opaque_calls_per_case'] == 1 and manifest['action_opaque_calls'] == 1
        assert manifest['action_replayed_with_changing_bounds'] is True and manifest['preparation_input'] == 17
        assert manifest['binary_sha256'] == campaign['all_campaign']['executable_sha256'][variant]
        verify(Path(manifest['build']) / 'benchmark', manifest['binary_sha256'])
        for name, digest in manifest['generated_source_sha256'].items():
            verify(name, digest)
        verify(directory / 'opaque-override.go', manifest['override_sha256'])
        stdout = (directory / 'stdout.txt').read_text()
        assert stdout == (directory / 'expected.txt').read_text() and not (directory / 'stderr.txt').read_text()
        assert len(stdout.splitlines()) == 168
        inputs = json.loads((directory / 'inputs.json').read_text())
        assert len(inputs) == 56
        if expected_inputs is not None:
            assert inputs == expected_inputs and stdout == expected_stdout
        expected_inputs, expected_stdout = inputs, stdout
        result[variant] = manifest
    return {'variants_per_build': 56, 'oracles_per_build': 168, 'total_oracles': 336,
            'same_inputs_and_outputs': True, 'manifests': result}


def compiler_changes(baseline):
    names = set(git('ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()) | set(baseline['sources'])
    tracked_before = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline['head']).splitlines())
    before, after, patch = {}, {}, ''
    for name in sorted(names):
        if not (name.startswith(('src/', 'runtime/', 'tools/', 'tests/', 'docs/')) or name in
                ['CHANGELOG.md', 'README.md', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'spago.yaml', 'spago.lock', 'bootstrap-sources.json']):
            continue
        if Path(name).suffix not in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs', '.mjs', '.md', '.json', '.yaml', '.lock'}:
            continue
        entry = baseline['sources'].get(name)
        old_from_git = False
        if entry:
            old = Path(entry['path']).read_text()
        elif name in tracked_before:
            # The snapshot intentionally selected only some paths. A tracked
            # file absent from it is not necessarily a newly created file.
            if baseline['status'] != '':
                raise ValueError('Cannot recover an unsnapshotted file from a dirty baseline: ' + name)
            old = git('show', baseline['head'] + ':' + name)
            old_from_git = True
        else:
            old = ''
        current = COMPILER / name
        new = current.read_text() if current.is_file() else ''
        if old == new:
            continue
        if entry:
            before[name] = artifact(entry['path'])
        elif old_from_git:
            before[name] = {'sha256': sha(old.encode()), 'size_bytes': len(old.encode()), 'text': old,
                            'baseline_git_object': baseline['head'] + ':' + name}
        after[name] = artifact(current) if current.is_file() else {'deleted': True}
        patch += ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True), fromfile='a/' + name, tofile='b/' + name))
    if not after:
        raise ValueError('Expected compiler changes relative to the frozen baseline')
    return before, after, {'sha256': sha(patch.encode()), 'text': patch}


def check_diagnostics(campaign):
    directory = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
    diagnostics = json.loads((directory / 'results.json').read_text())
    assert diagnostics['primary_campaign_sha256'] == sha((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_bytes())
    assert diagnostics['oracles_verified'] == 24 and len(diagnostics['cases']) == 4
    comparison = json.loads((directory / 'generated-comparison.json').read_text())
    for key, row in diagnostics['cases'].items():
        assert row['order'] == ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
        assert row['source_suite'] == ('core' if row['case'] == 'Polymorphism' else 'all')
        for side in ('before', 'after'):
            assert len(row['samples_us'][side]) == 3
            assert statistics.median(row['samples_us'][side]) == row['medians_us'][side]
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go'), row['main_sha256'][side])
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'), row['probe_binary_sha256'][side])
        change = 100 * (row['medians_us']['after'] / row['medians_us']['before'] - 1)
        assert math.isclose(change, row['change_percent'], rel_tol=1e-12)
        assert row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced'] == (change > 5)
        assert all(section['byte_identical'] and section['normalized_identical']
                   for section in comparison[key]['sections'].values())
    rbtree = json.loads((WORK / 'proofs/rbtree-comparison.json').read_text())
    assert all(section['byte_identical'] for section in rbtree['code'].values())
    assert rbtree['benchmarks_executed'] is False
    assert rbtree['paired_us']['after'] == campaign['primary_times_us']['after']['Red-Black Tree']
    return {'isolated_oracles': 24, 'increases_over_5_percent_reproduced':
            [row['case'] for row in diagnostics['cases'].values() if row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']],
            'rbtree_source_identical': True, 'rbtree_isolated_measurement': False,
            'primary_campaign_unchanged': True}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    campaign = json.loads((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_text())
    baseline = json.loads((WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json').read_text())
    checks = check_campaign(campaign)
    inputs = check_inputs(campaign)
    diagnostics = check_diagnostics(campaign)
    final = json.loads((WORK / 'validation-summary.json').read_text())
    if final.get('status') != 'passed':
        raise ValueError('Root-approved validation summary must be passed')
    for check in final.get('required_node_logs', []):
        text = (WORK / check['path']).read_text()
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ pass ' + str(check['passed']) + '$', text, re.M)
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ fail 0$', text, re.M)
    before, after, patch = compiler_changes(baseline)
    proofs = {}
    for path in sorted((WORK / 'proofs').rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.json', '.go', '.py', '.mjs', '.js', '.purs', '.md', '.stdout', '.stderr', '.txt', '.patch', '.log'}:
            proofs[str(path.relative_to(WORK / 'proofs'))] = artifact(path, omit=path.name == 'opaque-override.go')
    logs = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for pattern in
            ['validation-logs/*.log', 'logs/*.log', 'after-core/logs/*.log', 'after-all/logs/*.log']
            for path in sorted(WORK.glob(pattern))}
    campaign_files = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for path in sorted((WORK / 'campaign').rglob('*'))
                      if path.is_file() and path.name != 'results.json'}
    archive = {
        'date': '2026-11-26', 'archived_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'campaign': campaign,
        'report': {'path': str(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT)), **artifact(REPORT)},
        'compiler': {'baseline_head': baseline['head'], 'baseline_kind': 'clean committed compiler matching previous measured source snapshot',
                     'head_at_archive': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'status_at_archive': git('status', '--porcelain'),
                     'baseline_manifest': baseline, 'measured_snapshot': campaign['compiler_snapshot'],
                     'diff_from_baseline': patch, 'before_sources': before, 'changed_sources': after},
        'validation': {'final_summary': final, 'summary_source': artifact(WORK / 'validation-summary.json'),
                       'campaign': campaign['validation'], 'runtime_input_proofs': inputs,
                       'archive_checks': checks, 'diagnostic_checks': diagnostics, 'logs': logs},
        'proofs': {'runtime_inputs_and_collectors': proofs, 'campaign_files': campaign_files,
                   'original_collectors': {name: artifact(ROOT / name) for name in
                       ['bin/benchmark/measure.py', 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py', 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py',
                        'bin/benchmark/publish.py', 'bin/benchmark/validate.py']},
                   'reference_note': 'All 37 C medians are frozen. C/JS sources and historical times are unchanged; neither reference was remeasured.'},
        'preservation_note': 'Raw measurements, manifests, source snapshots, compiler changes and validation evidence are retained in the workspace and archived here. The deleted repository ratio catalogue is not recreated.'}
    serialized = json.dumps(archive, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n'
    if args.write:
        if OUTPUT.exists():
            raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an archive')
        OUTPUT.write_text(serialized)
    print(json.dumps({'written': args.write, 'path': str(OUTPUT), 'bytes': len(serialized.encode()),
                      'sha256': sha(serialized.encode()), 'compiler_changed_files': list(after),
                      'checks': checks, 'runtime_oracles': inputs['total_oracles']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')

frozen = json.loads((SCRIPTS / 'freeze.json').read_text())
pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
environment = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ('GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOPURS_JS', 'GOPURS_RUST', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT'):
    environment.pop(key, None)
commands = []
for kind in ([args.only] if args.only else ['core', 'all']):
    destination = WORK / ('after-' + kind)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an after build: ' + str(destination))
    commands.append([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'bin/native/driver.py'), 'go', '--build-only',
                     '--build-dir', str(destination), *(['--wip-included'] if kind == 'all' else [])])
if not args.execute:
    print(json.dumps({'commands': commands, 'environment': {'GOGC': '800', 'GOWORK': 'off', 'compiler_host': 'native'},
                      'benchmarks_executed': False}, indent=2))
else:
    compiler = pair['compiler_snapshot']()
    for command in commands:
        pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, check=True)
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
    pair['write'](WORK / 'after-build-compiler.json', compiler)
    print('After build(s) completed; no benchmark was executed.', flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Separate AB/BA/AB diagnostics for four increases, preserving primary samples."""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib, hashlib, json, math, os, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
WORK = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-ref-loops-20261126'
PROOF = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('compare-generated.py')))
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
primary = WORK / 'campaign/results.json'
primary_sha = sha(primary)
report = json.loads(primary.read_text())
labels = ['record/set-large-1000', 'string/cu-length-unicode-1000', 'string/indexOf-miss-10000', 'Polymorphism']
rows = {row['case']: row for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending']}
assert all(rows[label]['change_percent'] > 5 for label in labels)
cases = []
for label in labels:
    row = report['all_campaign']['all_tests'][label]
    core = label in report['primary_times_us']['after']
    cases.append({'key': re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', '-', label), 'label': label,
                  'module': row['module'].replace('.', '_'),
                  'getter': 'Get_' + row['module'].replace('.', '_') + ('_act' if core else '_prepare'),
                  'expected': row['expected'], 'prepare': not core, 'source_suite': 'core' if core else 'all',
                  'primary_change_percent': rows[label]['change_percent']})
builds = {scope: {side: WORK / (side + '-' + scope) for side in ('before', 'after')} for scope in ('core', 'all')}
env = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT']:
    env.pop(key, None)
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(PROOF / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases, indent=2) + '\n')
inventories = {scope: {side: HELPERS['inventory'](path) for side, path in pair.items()} for scope, pair in builds.items()}
originals = {scope: {side: inventory['provenance'] for side, inventory in pair.items()} for scope, pair in inventories.items()}
commands, sources, comparisons = {}, {}, {}


def normalize(body):
    # Canonicalize only generated package aliases/runtime spelling and trailing
    # whitespace; preserve calls, literals, arithmetic, local names and order.
    body = re.sub(r'\b(?:g[0-9a-f]{6})\.', 'package.', body.decode())
    body = re.sub(r'\br_\.', 'r.', body)
    return '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in body.splitlines()).strip() + '\n'


# First compare target module and original harness sections, before building probes.
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    selected = {'Bench.go', 'Bench_ffi.go', 'Effect_Console.go', 'Effect_Console_ffi.go', case['module'] + '.go'}
    extracted = {side: {Path(name).name: body for name, body in inventory['sections'].items() if Path(name).name in selected}
                 for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items()}
    assert set(extracted['before']) == set(extracted['after'])
    comparisons[key] = {'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'sections': {}}
    for name in extracted['before']:
        old, new = extracted['before'][name], extracted['after'][name]
        a, b = normalize(old), normalize(new)
        comparisons[key]['sections'][name] = {'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),
                                              'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),
                                              'byte_identical': old == new, 'normalized_identical': a == b,
                                              'before': old.decode(), 'after': new.decode(),
                                              'normalized_diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True), b.splitlines(True)))}
    assert all(item['normalized_identical'] for item in comparisons[key]['sections'].values()), ('Changed target/harness code', key)
(PROOF / 'generated-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2) + '\n')
print('All four target modules and selected harness sections are unchanged after normalization.', flush=True)

for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    commands[key], sources[key] = {}, {}
    for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items():
        owner = lambda name: [str(Path(path).parent) for path, body in inventory['sections'].items()
                              if re.search(rb'func ' + name.encode() + rb'\(', body)]
        action, bench, console = owner(case['getter']), owner('Call_Bench_runBench'), owner('Get_Effect_Console_log')
        assert len(action) == len(bench) == len(console) == 1
        packages = sorted(set(action + bench + console))
        aliases = {name: 'p' + str(i) for i, name in enumerate(packages)}
        imports = '; '.join(aliases[name] + ' "gopurs/output/' + name + '"' for name in packages)
        act = aliases[action[0]] + '.' + case['getter'] + '()'
        if case['prepare']:
            act = 'r.Apply(' + act + ',r.Value{})'
        main = f'''package main
import(r "gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"; {imports})
func main(){{
 act:={act}
 for i:=0;i<3;i++{{if value:=r.Apply(act,r.Value{{}});value.Type!=r.TypeInt||value.IntVal!={case['expected']}{{panic("invalid global warmup result")}}}}
 describe:=r.Apply({aliases[console[0]]}.Get_Effect_Console_log(),r.Str("{case['label']}"))
 r.Apply({aliases[bench[0]]}.Call_Bench_runBench(describe,act),r.Value{{}})
}}
'''
        source = PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go')
        source.write_text(main)
        sources[key][side] = sha(source)
        command = ['go', 'build', '-pgo=off', '-o', str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')), str(source)]
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        commands[key][side] = command
        print('Built', key, side, flush=True)

# All eight probe builds complete before the first timed process.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
from validate import ROW
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
results = {}
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    samples, runs = {'before': [], 'after': []}, []
    for index, side in enumerate(order, 1):
        process = subprocess.run([str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'))],
                                 cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env,
                                 text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        stem = f'{key}-{index}-{side}'
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        values = ROW.findall(process.stdout)
        assert len(values) == 1 and process.stdout.count('(Test)') == 1
        label, value, elapsed = values[0]
        assert label.strip() == case['label'] and value.strip() == str(case['expected'])
        elapsed = float(elapsed)
        assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed > 0
        batches = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Batch iterations: (\d+)$', process.stdout, re.M)]
        assert len(batches) == 1 and 0 < batches[0] <= 16777216 and not batches[0] & (batches[0] - 1)
        samples[side].append(elapsed)
        runs.append({'variant': side, 'time_us': elapsed, 'batch_iterations': batches[0],
                     'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr})
        print(stem, elapsed, 'us', flush=True)
    medians = {side: statistics.median(values) for side, values in samples.items()}
    change = 100 * (medians['after'] / medians['before'] - 1)
    results[key] = {'case': case['label'], 'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'expected': case['expected'],
                    'original_builds': originals[case['source_suite']], 'commands': commands[key],
                    'main_sha256': sources[key], 'probe_binary_sha256': {side: sha(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')) for side in samples},
                    'order': order, 'samples_us': samples, 'medians_us': medians, 'change_percent': change,
                    'primary_change_percent': case['primary_change_percent'], 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced': change > 5,
                    'runs': runs}
for scope, pair in builds.items():
    for side, path in pair.items():
        assert originals[scope][side] == HELPERS['inventory'](path)['provenance']
assert sha(primary) == primary_sha
result = {'measured_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope': 'Separate diagnostics only; original primary samples and aggregates remain unchanged',
          'protocol': 'AB/BA/AB for each case; actual getters and unchanged Bench.runBench; 3 global warmups then calibration and minimum of ten batches; all builds finished before timing',
          'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'host_isolated': False,
          'source_comparison': 'generated-comparison.json', 'script_sha256': sha(__file__),
          'primary_campaign_sha256': primary_sha, 'cases': results, 'oracles_verified': 24,
          'original_generated_sources_and_binaries_unchanged': True}
(PROOF / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: {name: row[name] for name in ['case', 'source_suite', 'samples_us', 'medians_us', 'change_percent', 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']}
                  for key, row in results.items()}, indent=2))

manifest = {

    'status': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True),

    'note': 'Clean committed baseline matching every compiler source and executable in the prior native-callback campaign.',

assert manifest['status'] == ''
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()
extra = ['bin/gopurs', 'bin/gopurs-native', 'bin/gopurs.js',
         'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.go', 'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.js', 'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.rs']

shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'README.md', WORK / 'README.before.md')

for name, digest in frozen['source_sha256'].items():

protected = [path for folder in ('src', 'srx', 'bin/benchmark', 'bin/native')
             for path in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts]

ports = [(ROOT / json.loads(match[1])).resolve() for match in

frozen['library_sources_sha256'] = {
    str(path): sha(path) for port in ports for path in (port / 'src').rglob('*') if path.is_file()}

                               for port in ports}

frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest_sha256'] = sha(mp)
frozen['historical_archive'] = {'path': str(history_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha(history_path)}

campaign = history['campaign']

frozen['historical_go_all_times_us'] = {name: row['medians_us']['after'] for name, row in campaign['all_campaign']['all_tests'].items()}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pair frozen Go App/AppAll builds against all 37 unchanged archived C medians."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import runpy
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
C = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py'))
J = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py'))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def metrics(times, reference):
    if set(times) != set(reference) or len(times) not in (14, 37):
        raise ValueError('Identical Go/C case populations of 14 or 37 required')
    ratios = [times[name] / reference[name] for name in times]
    if any(not math.isfinite(x) or x <= 0 for x in ratios):
        raise ValueError('Invalid ratio')
    return {'total': sum(times.values()) / sum(reference.values()),
            'arithmetic': statistics.mean(ratios), 'median': statistics.median(ratios),
            'geometric': math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(x) for x in ratios))}


def verify_freeze(frozen):
    baseline_path = Path(frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest'])
    if sha(baseline_path) != frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Compiler baseline manifest changed')
    baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
    for group in ['files', 'sources']:
        C['verify_hashes']({entry['path']: entry['sha256'] for entry in baseline[group].values()})
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['source_sha256'], ROOT)
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['library_sources_sha256'])
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['reference_files_sha256'])
    for build in [frozen['go_before_core'], frozen['c_build']]:
        C['verify_hashes']({build['manifest_path']: build['manifest_sha256']})
        C['verify_hashes'](build['payload_sha256'])
    old_all = frozen['go_before_all']
    path = Path(old_all['directory'])
    C['verify_hashes']({str(path / 'manifest.json'): old_all['manifest_sha256'],
                       str(path / 'benchmark'): old_all['manifest']['binary_sha256']})


def compiler_snapshot():
    root = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
    paths = [root / 'bin/gopurs-native', root / 'bin/gopurs.js', root / 'bin/gopurs']
    paths += [path for folder in ['src', 'runtime'] for path in sorted((root / folder).rglob('*'))
              if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs'}]
    return {'root': str(root),
            'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(root), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
            'files_sha256': {str(path): sha(path) for path in paths}}


def plan_entry(key, build):
    return {'key': key, 'mode': 'pure', 'command': build['command'],
            'artifact': build['cwd'], 'cwd': build['cwd'],
            'manifest': build['manifest_path'], 'manifest_sha256': build['manifest_sha256'],
            'payload_sha256': build['payload_sha256'],
            'executable_sha256': build['manifest']['binary_sha256']}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--freeze', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name('freeze.json'))
    parser.add_argument('--after-core', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--after-all', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true', help='run only after all builds and tests have finished')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    frozen = json.loads(args.freeze.read_text())
    verify_freeze(frozen)
    before_core = C['inspect_go'](Path(frozen['go_before_core']['cwd']))
    after_core = C['inspect_go'](args.after_core.resolve())
    before_all = J['inspect'](Path(frozen['go_before_all']['directory']))
    after_all = J['inspect'](args.after_all.resolve())
    for label, before, after in [('core', before_core['manifest'], after_core['manifest']),
                                 ('all', before_all, after_all)]:
        for field in ['profile', 'toolchain']:
            if before[field] != after[field]:
                raise ValueError(f'{label} build {field} differs')
        for name in before['inputs']:
            if name.startswith(('src/', 'srx/')) and before['inputs'][name] != after['inputs'].get(name):
                raise ValueError(f'{label} benchmark input differs: {name}')
    if before_core['command'] == after_core['command'] or Path(frozen['go_before_all']['directory']) == args.after_all.resolve():
        raise ValueError('Distinct before/after builds are required')
    plan = [plan_entry('before', before_core), plan_entry('after', after_core)]
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'validated': True, 'core_plan': plan,
                          'all_pair': [frozen['go_before_all']['directory'], str(args.after_all.resolve())],
                          'C_reference_remeasured': False, 'processes': 12}, indent=2))
        return
    args.output = args.output.resolve()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write(args.output / 'freeze.json', frozen)
    write(args.output / 'core-plan.json', plan)
    env = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800')
    for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF']:
        env.pop(key, None)
    compiler = compiler_snapshot()
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    load_start = list(os.getloadavg())
    commands = [
        [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/measure.py'), '--plan',
         str(args.output / 'core-plan.json'), '--output', str(args.output / 'core')],
        [sys.executable, '-B', str(Path(__file__).with_name('collect-all.py')), '--before',
         frozen['go_before_all']['directory'], '--after', str(args.after_all.resolve()),
         '--output', str(args.output / 'all')],
    ]
    for command in commands:
        verify_freeze(frozen)
        C['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, check=True)
        verify_freeze(frozen)
        C['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
    core = json.loads((args.output / 'core/results.json').read_text())
    all_cases = json.loads((args.output / 'all/results.json').read_text())
    labels = C['ROWS']
    core_times = {variant: dict(zip(labels, data['times_us'])) for variant, data in core.items()}
    core_aggregates = {variant: metrics(times, frozen['c_times_us']) for variant, times in core_times.items()}
    core_historical = metrics(frozen['historical_go_core_times_us'], frozen['c_times_us'])
    for key, value in core_historical.items():
        if not math.isclose(value, frozen['historical_aggregates'][key], rel_tol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError('Historical metrics do not reproduce the official archive')
    # Preserve the publication's primary App medians for core14, and use AppAll
    # for library23 only. Both sides of every aggregate now contain all 37 cases.
    matched37 = {
        variant: {name: core_times[variant][name] if name in core_times[variant]
                  else row['medians_us'][variant]
                  for name, row in all_cases['all_tests'].items()}
        for variant in ('before', 'after')}
    aggregates = {variant: metrics(times, frozen['c37_times_us']) for variant, times in matched37.items()}
    historical = metrics(frozen['historical_go37_times_us'], frozen['c37_times_us'])
    for key, prior_key in [('total', '/'), ('arithmetic', 'μ'), ('median', 'Q₂'), ('geometric', 'G')]:
        if not math.isclose(historical[key], frozen['historical37_aggregates'][prior_key], rel_tol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError('Historical 37-case metrics do not reproduce the official README')
    rows = []
    for name in matched37['after']:
        before, after = matched37['before'][name], matched37['after'][name]
        if name in labels:
            index = labels.index(name)
            samples = {variant: [sample['times_us'][index] for sample in core[variant]['process_runs']]
                       for variant in ['before', 'after']}
        else:
            samples = all_cases['all_tests'][name]['samples_us']
        rows.append({'case': name, 'times_us': {'before': before, 'after': after, 'c': frozen['c37_times_us'][name]},
                     'go_over_c': {variant: times[name] / frozen['c37_times_us'][name] for variant, times in matched37.items()},
                     'samples_us': samples, 'speedup': before / after, 'change_percent': 100 * (after / before - 1),
                     'before_over_historical': before / frozen['historical_go37_times_us'][name]})
    all_regressions = sorted([{'case': name, 'change_percent': case['change_percent'],
                              'medians_us': case['medians_us'], 'samples_us': case['samples_us']}
                             for name, case in all_cases['all_tests'].items() if case['change_percent'] > 5],
                            key=lambda row: -row['change_percent'])
    raw_core = {path.name: path.read_text() for suffix in ['stdout', 'stderr']
                for path in sorted((args.output / 'core').glob('*.' + suffix))}
    report = {'started_at_utc': started, 'completed_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              'host': platform.platform(), 'machine': platform.machine(), 'host_isolated': False,
              'load_average_start': load_start, 'load_average_end': list(os.getloadavg()),
              'protocol': {'paired_order': 'AB/BA/AB', 'processes_per_build': 3,
                           'primary': '14 App core medians plus 23 AppAll library medians; all four Go/C aggregates use 37 matched cases',
                           'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'pgo': False,
                           'C_reference_remeasured': False, 'JS_reference_remeasured': False,
                           'aggregation': 'median of three process minima for each case'},
              'commands': commands, 'wrapper_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
              'frozen_reference': frozen, 'compiler_snapshot': compiler, 'aggregates': aggregates, 'historical_aggregates': historical,
              'primary_times_us': core_times, 'primary_total_ms': {k: sum(v.values())/1000 for k,v in core_times.items()},
              'matched37_times_us': matched37, 'matched37_total_ms': {k: sum(v.values())/1000 for k,v in matched37.items()},
              'core14_aggregates': core_aggregates, 'historical_core14_aggregates': core_historical,
              'c_total_ms': sum(frozen['c37_times_us'].values())/1000,
              'rows_by_go_c_descending': sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r['go_over_c']['after']),
              'all_case_regressions_over_5_percent': all_regressions,
              'validation': {'processes': 12, 'core_oracles': 84, 'all_oracles': 222,
                             'total_oracles': 306, 'source_and_binary_guards': True},
              'core_manifest': json.loads((args.output / 'core/manifest.json').read_text()),
              'core_campaign': core, 'raw_core_outputs': raw_core, 'all_campaign': all_cases}
    write(args.output / 'results.json', report)
    print(json.dumps({'aggregates': aggregates, 'historical': historical,
                      'totals_ms': report['matched37_total_ms'], 'c_total_ms': report['c_total_ms'],
                      'all_regressions_over_5_percent': all_regressions}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare the report from validated paired data and an implementation summary."""
import argparse, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
from publish import format_number

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--implementation', type=Path, default=WORK / 'implementation.md')
parser.add_argument('--validation', type=Path, default=WORK / 'validation-summary.json')
parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true', help='write the tracked report only on root authorization')
args = parser.parse_args()
campaign = json.loads((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_text())
validation = json.loads(args.validation.read_text())
if validation.get('status') != 'passed':
    raise ValueError('Final validation must be passed')
implementation = args.implementation.read_text().strip()
if not implementation:
    raise ValueError('Describe the actual implemented optimization before publication')
refs = ('st/ref-write-10000', 'st/ref-modify-10000', 'effect/ref-write-10000', 'effect/ref-modify-10000')
rows = {row['case']: row for row in campaign['rows_by_go_c_descending']}
lines = ['# Go ST.Ref and Effect.Ref optimization', '', implementation, '',
         'Benchmarks, harnesses, library FFI and C references are unchanged. Runtime inputs remain opaque.', '',
         '## Reference workloads', '',
         '| Case | Official Go baseline (µs) | Paired before (µs) | After (µs) | Speedup in this pair |',
         '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
for name in refs:
    row = rows[name]
    historical = campaign['frozen_reference']['historical_go37_times_us'][name]
    lines.append(f'| `{name}` | {format_number(historical)} | {format_number(row["times_us"]["before"])} | '
                 f'{format_number(row["times_us"]["after"])} | {format_number(row["speedup"])}× |')
lines += ['', '## All 37 matched Go/C cases', '',
          '| Indicator | Official baseline | Paired before | After |',
          '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
for label, key in [('Ratio of totals', 'total'), ('Arithmetic mean μ', 'arithmetic'),
                   ('Median Q₂', 'median'), ('Geometric mean G', 'geometric')]:
    values = [campaign['historical_aggregates'][key], campaign['aggregates']['before'][key], campaign['aggregates']['after'][key]]
    lines.append('| ' + label + ' | ' + ' | '.join(format_number(value) + '×' for value in values) + ' |')
lines += ['', 'All four indicators use the same 37 measured Go/C pairs: 14 core medians from App and 23 library medians from AppAll. '
          'The C denominator remains frozen at ' + str(campaign['c_total_ms']) + ' ms. '
          'Differences between the official baseline and the fresh before measurement reflect measurement variation, not this compiler change.', '',
          '## Measurement and validation', '',
          'Three independent processes per build, in AB/BA/AB order; three global warm-ups, three local warm-ups, '
          'calibrated batches and the minimum of ten batches per process. Published rows use medians across the three processes. '
          'Release Go, GOGC=800, default GOMAXPROCS, no PGO. All builds and tests finish before measurement. The host is not isolated.', '',
          'The App/AppAll campaign validates 306 measured outputs. Source and binary hashes are checked around each collection. '
          'The archived validation summary and runtime-input proofs record the targeted tests, varied inputs, repeatability and opaque-call checks.', '',
          'Full commands, original outputs, compiler changes, input proofs and validation logs are preserved in '
          '[the JSON archive](2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.json) and `var/benchmark/go-ref-loops-20261126`.', '']
anomalies = sorted([row for row in campaign['rows_by_go_c_descending'] if row['change_percent'] > 5],
                   key=lambda row: -row['change_percent'])
lines += ['## Regression review', '']
if anomalies:
    lines += ['The primary 37-case combination (App14 and AppAll23) contains these increases above 5%; they are retained in the measurements:', '']
    for row in anomalies:
        lines.append('- `' + row['case'] + '`: +' + format_number(row['change_percent']) + '%.')
    review = WORK / 'regression-review.md'
    if not review.exists() or not review.read_text().strip():
        raise ValueError('Document the regression review before publishing a report with increases above 5%')
    lines += ['', review.read_text().strip(), '']
else:
    lines += ['No published case increased by more than 5% in the primary pair.', '']
text = '\n'.join(lines)
preview = WORK / 'report.proposed.md'
preview.write_text(text)
output = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.md'
if args.write:
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an existing report')
    output.write_text(text)
print(json.dumps({'preview': str(preview), 'report': str(output), 'written': args.write}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Retain targeted evidence from the final generated Go; execute no benchmark."""
import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
build = WORK / 'after-all'
manifest = json.loads((build / 'manifest.json').read_text())
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert sha((build / 'benchmark').read_bytes()) == manifest['binary_sha256']
sources = [(path, path.read_text()) for path in (build / 'output/purescript').rglob('*.go')]


def balanced(text, start):
    assert text[start] == '{'
    depth = 0
    for end in range(start, len(text)):
        depth += (text[end] == '{') - (text[end] == '}')
        if depth == 0:
            return text[start:end + 1]
    raise ValueError('Unbalanced Go body')


results = {}
for name in ('STRefWrite10000', 'STRefModify10000', 'EffectRefWrite10000', 'EffectRefModify10000'):
    symbol = 'Get_Test_' + name + '_prepare'
    matches = []
    for path, text in sources:
        found = re.search(r'^func ' + symbol + r'\([^\n]*\{', text, re.M)
        if found:
            matches.append((path, text, found))
    assert len(matches) == 1
    path, text, found = matches[0]
    body = balanced(text, found.end() - 1)
    assert body.count('Bench_Opaque_runEffectWorker(') == 1
    assert body.count('Get_Bench_opaque()') == 1
    assert re.search(r'Apply\(__local_var_\d+_\d+, r_?\.Value\{\}\)', body)
    if 'Modify' in name:
        fast = body
        assert 'IntMul(' in fast and 'IntAdd(' in fast
        assert '2147483647' not in fast
    else:
        guard = re.search(r'if \([^\n]+\.IntVal\) < \(int64\(2147483647\)\) \{', body)
        assert guard
        fast = balanced(body, guard.end() - 1)
        assert 'Call_Test_' + name + '_write' in body
    assert not re.search(r'\bfor\b|NewSTRef|ReadSTRef|WriteSTRef|Ref__new|Ref_read|newImpl|Call_Test_', fast)
    results[name] = {'source': str(path), 'source_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes()),
                     'prepare_body': body, 'fast_path': fast,
                     'opaque_preparation_and_action_preserved': True,
                     'fast_path_has_no_ref_allocation_or_loop_call': True,
                     'max_int32_guard_and_original_fallback': 'Write' in name}
output = {'build': str(build), 'binary_sha256': manifest['binary_sha256'], 'cases': results,
          'validated': True, 'benchmarks_executed': False,
          'note': 'Static generated-code review; runtime replay/opacity behavior is independently checked by ref-input-proof.py.'}
(WORK / 'proofs/generated-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'cases': list(results), 'binary_sha256': manifest['binary_sha256'],
                  'all_fast_paths_constant_work_on_opaque_bound': True}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only independent consistency checks for the archived reference-loop campaign."""
import hashlib, json, runpy, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.json'
raw = path.read_bytes()
archive = json.loads(raw)
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
count = 0


def visit(value):
    global count
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        if isinstance(value.get('text'), str) and 'sha256' in value:
            assert sha(value['text'].encode()) == value['sha256']
            count += 1
        for child in value.values():
            visit(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            visit(child)


visit(archive)
helper = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('archive.py')))
checks = helper['check_campaign'](archive['campaign'])
assert checks == archive['validation']['archive_checks']
assert helper['check_inputs'](archive['campaign']) == archive['validation']['runtime_input_proofs']
assert helper['check_diagnostics'](archive['campaign']) == archive['validation']['diagnostic_checks']
assert archive['validation']['final_summary'] == json.loads((WORK / 'validation-summary.json').read_text())
assert archive['report']['text'] == (ROOT / archive['report']['path']).read_text()
for name, evidence in archive['validation']['logs'].items():
    assert sha((WORK / name).read_bytes()) == evidence['sha256'], name
for name, evidence in archive['proofs']['runtime_inputs_and_collectors'].items():
    assert sha((WORK / 'proofs' / name).read_bytes()) == evidence['sha256'], name
assert not (ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/ratio-measurements.json').exists()
print(json.dumps({'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw),
                  'embedded_text_hashes_verified': count, 'campaign': checks,
                  'runtime_oracles': archive['validation']['runtime_input_proofs']['total_oracles'],
                  'removed_catalogue_remains_absent': True}, indent=2))

# 🌈 PureScript universal multi-runtime benchmark ## Project goal This project is a **proof of concept** demonstrating the power of abstraction and portability offered by **PureScript**. The goal is to show how the exact same pure functional code (without any manual FFI) can be compiled and executed natively on radically different ecosystems. Backends consume either standard `CoreFn` or, for the local AOT backends, the typed `TAST/tcorefn` representation exported by a local PureScript fork (may be subject to an official PR soon). ## Comprehensive benchmarks The benchmark suite runs a **wide variety** of computationally intensive tasks: AST evaluation, massive list processing, tail call optimization, deep record updates... These tests apply massive **pressure** on the call stack, garbage collector, disk I/O, event loops, and runtime execution engines to measure the raw ability of the compiler and the underlying virtual machine. > [!NOTE] > **Reading the benchmark tables** > > - **Status, only for gopurs, purust, phpurs, sharpurs and javapurs:** **Stable** = measured and considered fully optimized; **WIP** = measured, with optimization work remaining; **Backlog** = planned work without a published measurement or ratio. Status labels belong only to the relevant backend columns. References and external backends have no status. Stable is currently empty, including for Go: the available analyses still identify optimization opportunities. > - **Ratios:** `/C` uses the optimized imperative C reference; `/JS` uses the first JavaScript column. **Below 1× is faster; above 1× is slower.** Extended Results uses its own JS reference and has no C reference. > - **Totals:** sums of the available per-test medians: **Total WIP** for the controlled backends, **Total** for references and external backends. Backlog never contributes. Empty Stable groups are shown as *Coming soon...* and have no defined total, ratio or mean. These totals do not represent an application benchmark. > - **Summaries:** `μ` = arithmetic mean, `Q₂` = median, `G` = geometric mean of the case ratios. Each case has equal weight. All four ratios use exactly the same measured cases on both sides: Go/C and Go/JS both cover all 37 measured Go cases. The full total of a reference table is not used as a denominator for a different set of cases. Very small reference times can produce large ratios. > - **Missing data:** `—` means unavailable or not applicable, never zero. Bounds (`< …`) are excluded from summaries. `n=a/b` indicates coverage: measured cases out of listed cases for a time total, or matched references out of measured cases for a ratio. Historical diagnostic measurements remain in the reference tables; their controlled-backend counterparts belong to unmeasured Backlog. > - **Display precision, in every table:** values ≥ 1 use two decimal places (`12.000045 → 12.00`); positive values < 1 keep two significant digits after leading zeros (`0.000045`, `0.009492 → 0.0095`). Zero is `0.00`. > - **Opaque inputs, in every table:** inputs must remain unknown to the optimizer at runtime. Algebraic simplification is allowed; substituting the driver’s known input is not. > - **Calculations:** use archived timings before display rounding, including for threshold checks. `≈` marks a fallback to published precision. ### Core stresstest benchmark results (pure computational) **Core tests (`src/`)** cover features common to all tested targets (`./bin/run`) #### JavaScript JS Benchmark | Hand-written PureScript

# 🌈 PureScript universal multi-runtime benchmark ## Project goal This project is a **proof of concept** demonstrating the power of abstraction and portability offered by **PureScript**. The goal is to show how the exact same pure functional code (without any manual FFI) can be compiled and executed natively on radically different ecosystems. Backends consume either standard `CoreFn` or, for the local AOT backends, the typed `TAST/tcorefn` representation exported by a local PureScript fork (may be subject to an official PR soon). ## Comprehensive benchmarks The benchmark suite runs a **wide variety** of computationally intensive tasks: AST evaluation, massive list processing, tail call optimization, deep record updates... These tests apply massive **pressure** on the call stack, garbage collector, disk I/O, event loops, and runtime execution engines to measure the raw ability of the compiler and the underlying virtual machine. > [!NOTE] > **Reading the benchmark tables** > > - **Status, only for gopurs, purust, phpurs, sharpurs and javapurs:** **Stable** = measured and considered fully optimized; **WIP** = measured, with optimization work remaining; **Backlog** = planned work without a published measurement or ratio. Status labels belong only to the relevant backend columns. References and external backends have no status. Stable is currently empty, including for Go: the available analyses still identify optimization opportunities. > - **Ratios:** `/C` uses the optimized imperative C reference; `/JS` uses the first JavaScript column. **Below 1× is faster; above 1× is slower.** Extended Results uses its own JS reference and has no C reference. > - **Totals:** sums of the available per-test medians: **Total WIP** for the controlled backends, **Total** for references and external backends. Backlog never contributes. Empty Stable groups are shown as *Coming soon...* and have no defined total, ratio or mean. These totals do not represent an application benchmark. > - **Summaries:** `μ` = arithmetic mean, `Q₂` = median, `G` = geometric mean of the case ratios. Each case has equal weight. All four ratios use exactly the same measured cases on both sides: Go/C and Go/JS both cover all 37 measured Go cases. The full total of a reference table is not used as a denominator for a different set of cases. Very small reference times can produce large ratios. > - **Missing data:** `—` means unavailable or not applicable, never zero. Bounds (`< …`) are excluded from summaries. `n=a/b` indicates coverage: measured cases out of listed cases for a time total, or matched references out of measured cases for a ratio. Historical diagnostic measurements remain in the reference tables; their controlled-backend counterparts belong to unmeasured Backlog. > - **Display precision, in every table:** values ≥ 1 use two decimal places (`12.000045 → 12.00`); positive values < 1 keep two significant digits after leading zeros (`0.000045`, `0.009492 → 0.0095`). Zero is `0.00`. > - **Opaque inputs, in every table:** inputs must remain unknown to the optimizer at runtime. Algebraic simplification is allowed; substituting the driver’s known input is not. > - **Calculations:** use archived timings before display rounding, including for threshold checks. `≈` marks a fallback to published precision. ### Core stresstest benchmark results (pure computational) **Core tests (`src/`)** cover features common to all tested targets (`./bin/run`) #### JavaScript JS Benchmark | Hand-written PureScript

# 🌈 PureScript universal multi-runtime benchmark ## Project goal This project is a **proof of concept** demonstrating the power of abstraction and portability offered by **PureScript**. The goal is to show how the exact same pure functional code (without any manual FFI) can be compiled and executed natively on radically different ecosystems. Backends consume either standard `CoreFn` or, for the local AOT backends, the typed `TAST/tcorefn` representation exported by a local PureScript fork (may be subject to an official PR soon). ## Comprehensive benchmarks The benchmark suite runs a **wide variety** of computationally intensive tasks: AST evaluation, massive list processing, tail call optimization, deep record updates... These tests apply massive **pressure** on the call stack, garbage collector, disk I/O, event loops, and runtime execution engines to measure the raw ability of the compiler and the underlying virtual machine. > [!NOTE] > **Reading the benchmark tables** > > - **Status, only for gopurs, purust, phpurs, sharpurs and javapurs:** **Stable** = measured and considered fully optimized; **WIP** = measured, with optimization work remaining; **Backlog** = planned work without a published measurement or ratio. Status labels belong only to the relevant backend columns. References and external backends have no status. Stable is currently empty, including for Go: the available analyses still identify optimization opportunities. > - **Ratios:** `/C` uses the optimized imperative C reference; `/JS` uses the first JavaScript column. **Below 1× is faster; above 1× is slower.** Extended Results uses its own JS reference and has no C reference. > - **Totals:** sums of the available per-test medians: **Total WIP** for the controlled backends, **Total** for references and external backends. Backlog never contributes. Empty Stable groups are shown as *Coming soon...* and have no defined total, ratio or mean. These totals do not represent an application benchmark. > - **Summaries:** `μ` = arithmetic mean, `Q₂` = median, `G` = geometric mean of the case ratios. Each case has equal weight. All four ratios use exactly the same measured cases on both sides: Go/C and Go/JS both cover all 37 measured Go cases. The full total of a reference table is not used as a denominator for a different set of cases. Very small reference times can produce large ratios. > - **Missing data:** `—` means unavailable or not applicable, never zero. Bounds (`< …`) are excluded from summaries. `n=a/b` indicates coverage: measured cases out of listed cases for a time total, or matched references out of measured cases for a ratio. Historical diagnostic measurements remain in the reference tables; their controlled-backend counterparts belong to unmeasured Backlog. > - **Display precision, in every table:** values ≥ 1 use two decimal places (`12.000045 → 12.00`); positive values < 1 keep two significant digits after leading zeros (`0.000045`, `0.009492 → 0.0095`). Zero is `0.00`. > - **Opaque inputs, in every table:** inputs must remain unknown to the optimizer at runtime. Algebraic simplification is allowed; substituting the driver’s known input is not. > - **Calculations:** use archived timings before display rounding, including for threshold checks. `≈` marks a fallback to published precision. ### Core stresstest benchmark results (pure computational) **Core tests (`src/`)** cover features common to all tested targets (`./bin/run`) #### JavaScript JS Benchmark | Hand-written PureScript
